connector.name: Mission Control
connector.registryDescription: Read and write Mission Control state via MCP - projects, tasks, subtasks, templates, status updates.
connector.summary: Hosted at mission-control-six-kohl.vercel.app over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the dinof777 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <token>. Get a per-user MCP token from Mission Control: open https://mission-control-six-kohl.vercel.app/settings/api-keys and click 'Generate MCP token'.
